# Protocol attribution

Protocol structures adapted from Tencent openclaw-weixin 2.4.10 (MIT). Upstream: https://github.com/Tencent/openclaw-weixin
Only HTTP/QR/poll/text structures are adapted; no OpenClaw runtime is bundled. Native Naumi IM owns sessions, authorization and persistence. QR generator 1.4.4 by Kazuhiko Arase (MIT), unchanged source plus ESM default export.
